object.description: Create an object, and create one after deleting the highest object; look at objects/. Write objects/DOC-1.xml holding object id DOC-99; separately rename objects/DOC-0.xml to DOC-7.xml after a read; read each. Read object file content with id DOC-1 as stored at a version under the name DOC-0.xml. Expected: each new object is in objects/<object ID>.xml, whose object element's id is that ID; each file whose name differs from its id is a load error saying so.
